Name: Ghostie Kitty
Author: cozysweetpotato
Description:
A spookier alternative to my spectral cat I present to you ghost kitty! Ghost kitty is a silly little kitty that floats around the farm. I hope all you aspiring witches fall in love with ghost kitty too. Content Patcher required (replaces 3rd cat). 

I am using the lovely Faedew reshade by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/11471909]rosenfey[/url] in my screenshots as well as Wildflower Grass Field by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty. 

[/url]This mod is part of a larger series I plan to make for cottage witches! The series will have a cozy cottagecore witchy vibe. 

I hope you enjoy this mod and thank you for your support ♡

(see also my other cat mod Spectral Cat)
